s:
Consider the following statements regarding Om Prakash Mathur:

1. He is the current Governor of Sikkim. (As of March 2025)

2. He was previously a member of Rajya Sabha from Rajasthan.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x:
Om Prakash Mathur is no longer Sikkim's Governor — now Governor of Kerala/Keralam (orders 12 Oct 2026), with Dushyant Gautam as Governor of Sikkim (Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.42; daily CA 15 Oct 2026 p.1)
As of March 2025 both statements were true: Om Prakash Mathur had been Governor of Sikkim since 31 July 2024, and he earlier represented Rajasthan in the Rajya Sabha (2008-14, 2016-22). (Now: he was transferred as Governor of Kerala/Keralam on 12 Oct 2026; Sikkim's Governor is Dushyant Gautam.)

s: Vande Mataram composed by Bankimchandra Chatterji
o: has an equal status with Jana Gana Mana, the National Anthem
was translated by Gandhiji into Gujarati
Was recognized by the UNO as a heritage property
x: On 24 January 1950 the Constituent Assembly adopted Vande Mataram as the National Song, with equal status/honour with Jana Gana Mana (Rajendra Prasad's statement). It is not a UN/UNESCO heritage item, and no source credits Gandhi with a Gujarati translation, so 'none of these' is wrong.

s: Which one of the following Carnatic music ragas is similar to Raga Bilawal in Hindustani music?
x: Hindustani Bilawal (all-natural, major-scale thaat) corresponds to the Carnatic 29th melakarta Dheera Shankarabharanam. Natabhairavi corresponds to Asavari, Kamavardhini (Pantuvarali) to Purvi/Puriya Dhanashri and Hanumatodi to the Bhairavi thaat.
